report.message_to_earth: Habitat status is nominal with the water heater confirmed non-operational. On 2015-01-17, the static water tank was refilled to full, but total water volume remaining is unknown, while engineering confirmed the water heater cannot produce hot water. The crew proposed replacing the water heater and is preparing a new total water volume estimate. Other systems are nominal, with propane at 37 percent providing about 23.1 days of supply, and diesel reported at less than 75 percent. Please advise on authorization and procedures for replacing the water heater by tomorrow. The crew will report again tomorrow.
